differences.reason: Dispatch is serial, with no concurrent launch before roster readback. The second request attaches to the in-flight dispatch.
differences.disposition: Safe label difference. WAIT explicitly forbids a concurrent launch before roster readback and attaches the repeated request to the pending dispatch.

differences.reason: Check 4 requires every other ID to be preserved. Dropping other fails it, so adoption is not permitted.
differences.disposition: Safe label difference. NOT_CONTINUED explicitly fails check 4 and prohibits adoption while another root ID is missing.

differences.reason: Re-reading the claim is required before any adoption. A failed read is unknown and blocks adoption and watch transfers.
differences.disposition: Safe label difference. DENY explicitly blocks adoption and watch transfer when the claim read is unknown.

differences.reason: Failed, stalled or unlisted successors are reported once to Home, the sole dispatcher. Process receives a copy only for recurring diagnostics.
differences.disposition: Safe label difference. DENY rejects Process-only reporting and explicitly requires Home recovery.

limits: Author-run bounded native Read-only installed-contract application. Not independent QA, live T3 effects, end-to-end Home succession, atomic claims, or cross-host filesystem/deploy proof.
